A food item, not to be confused with [[fried egg]], which restores {{Energy|+|20}} when consumed.  Since the items which can be used to craft a {{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}} lack quality levels it can not be improved by using higher quality ingredients. For more information on preparing food see [[cooking]].
